crossRefs.note: But Zion said, “Yahweh has forsaken me, and the Lord has forgotten me.”
You will not be called Forsaken any more, nor will your land be called Desolate any more; but you will be called…
“Say to your brothers, ‘My people!’ and to your sisters, ‘My loved one!’
Contend with your mother! Contend, for she is not my wife, neither am I her husband; and let her put away her…
“Therefore behold, I will allure her, and bring her into the wilderness, and speak tenderly to her.
I will give her vineyards from there, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope; and she will respond there, as in the…
“Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.
Nevertheless, he who comforts the lowly, God, comforted us by the coming of Titus,
I now rejoice, not that you were grieved, but that you were grieved to repentance. For you were grieved in a godly way…
For godly sorrow produces repentance to salvation, which brings no regret. But the sorrow of the world produces death.
Let your spring be blessed. Rejoice in the wife of your youth.
Live joyfully with the wife whom you love all the days of your life of vanity, which he has given you under the sun…
Yet you say, ‘Why?’ Because Yahweh has been witness between you and the wife of your youth, against whom you have dealt…

translations.web: For Yahweh has called you as a wife forsaken and grieved in spirit, even a wife of youth, when she is cast off,” says your God.
translations.bsb: For the LORD has called you back, like a wife deserted and wounded in spirit, like the rejected wife of one’s youth,” says your God.
translations.kjv: For the LORD hath called thee as a woman forsaken and grieved in spirit, and a wife of youth, when thou wast refused, saith thy God.
translations.asv: For Jehovah hath called thee as a wife forsaken and grieved in spirit, even a wife of youth, when she is cast off, saith thy God.
